info.title: xrm-metadata-sync
info.description: Interactive CLI tool to sync Dataverse metadata into XrmMockup format for XrmEmulator

commands.name: button
commands.description:
commandbar <app> edit <name>                       Edit/customize an existing
command bar button
ribbonworkbench hide <entity> <button-id>            Hide a ribbon button via

commands.name: definition
commands.description:
sla add-to-solution Add an SLA to the solution pcf push [--prefix kf] Build, validate and stage a PCF control for commit solution import [--skip-product-update-deps] Import a solution zip, optionally ignoring first-party package deps solution remove-component --type --id Remove a component from the solution (does NOT delete it) promote [--managed] [--no-overwrite] [--out ] Export a solution from one environment and import it into another (interactive, no env folder) plugin register|update|remove|sign ... Plug-in lifecycle (last is Authenticode sign) plugin attach-mi --client-id --tenant Bind plug-in assembly to a UAMI for KV access plugin step enable|disable Toggle a plugin step on/off (e.g. temporarily lift a guard) cert generate [--name ] [--out ] [--password

] [--years ] Generate a self-signed code-signing cert cert show-fic [--pfx ] [--password

] Print Power Platform federated identity credential values commit [--impersonate ] Push pending changes to CRM (data imports run as ) init-connection --environment-url [--client-id ] Write connection_metadata.json without a full sync (use before solution import) git-init Initialize git tracking in SolutionExport/

options.name: --impersonate
options.description:
Run data imports as this user — GUID, full name or
sign-in name
(env: DATAVERSE_IMPERSONATE). An import file naming its own
user wins.
Workflow:
1. Run full sync (no command) to pull metadata from CRM
2. Checkout components (views/forms/sitemap/entity) to _pending/
3. Edit files in _pending/
4. Run commit to push changes to CRM
